observed_evidence.release: Candidate PR #5297; production effectiveness and customer usability EVIDENCE_DUE.
gate_incidents: INTEGRATION_BUNDLE_CLOSURE_INCOMPLETE:brain_learning corrected by original learning record and executable replay

root_cause: Visual and input primitives were designed separately from the non-visual, error-recovery path. The new UX work initially omitted required PR candidate metadata and ONE BRAIN learning closure; both existing protected checks correctly rejected incomplete evidence.
fix: Enhance canonical Portal V2 without replacement: five existing chart families disclose exact source-derived rows as native details/tables, keyboard users can traverse existing marks, field controls link descriptions/errors and stop native-invalid callback propagation. Add single original brain-learning record, regression, skill incident protocol, human change documentation and ledger.
prevention_rules: Every new graph must offer a source-derived accessible data alternative; never turn absent values into verified zero in a new disclosure.
Every new field has a visible label, associated help/error and native validation; invalid values never trigger a save callback or a false server-success state.
No second Portal UX authority, InsightLens, brain, tenant read model, scheduler, writer, arbitrary cross-tenant cache or fake performance report.
Use only supported Candidate-Type: implementation for portal feature PRs; fail closed if metadata deviates.
Every material original portal change includes ONE BRAIN learning, human documentation, activity ledger and incident protocol, with executable brain-* regression.
Verify actual WCAG, 320/390/768/1024/1440 interaction matrix, protected Required/CodeQL/BRAIN, exact Netlify SHA and independent authenticated real-user results before claiming production proof.
owner: original Portal V2 protected UX and release authority
terminal_rule: Only independent protected checks plus exact-source Netlify and authenticated entrepreneur user readback can promote this beyond CANDIDATE; absent source/tenant evidence remains EVIDENCE_DUE.
